Friends
920 - The One With The Soap Opera Party

Teleplay: Andrew Reich & Ted Cohen
Story: Shana Goldberg-Meehan
Directed by: Sheldon Epps
Transcribed by: Eleonora, Pheeboh, Sebastiano & Vanessa

[Scene: Monica's apartment]

Joey: (enters the room) Hey, you guys, what are you doing tomorrow night?
（走进房间）嘿，你们，明天晚上要做什么？

Chandler: (browsing through a diary) Well, let me see...
（翻阅日记）好吧，让我想想…… I-I believe I'm...
我-我相信我是... yes, falling asleep in front of the TV.
是的，在电视机前睡着了。

Joey: Look, my agent hooked me up with six tickets to a great play.
看，我的经纪人给我介绍了六张精彩演出的门票。

Chandler: I could fall asleep at a play.
我可以在看戏时睡着。

Phoebe: What is it?
它是什么？

Joey: It's a one-woman play called "Why don't you like me: a bitter woman's journey through life".
是一出独角戏，叫《你为什么不喜欢我：一个怨妇的人生旅程》。

Monica: It sounds interesting!
听起来很有趣！

Ross: Yeah, it does sound interesting, I mean, to listen to a woman complain for two hours, I don't think it gets bett...
是的，听起来确实很有趣，我的意思是，听一个女人抱怨两个小时，我不认为这会更好...... (Ross starts snoring, faking to fall asleep)

Phoebe: I know, I know, we can drive, we can vote, we can work, what more do these broads want?
我知道，我知道，我们可以开车，我们可以投票，我们可以工作，这些女人还想要什么？

Joey: You guys are gonna have a great time, I promise!
你们会玩得很开心的，我保证！

Ross: What?
什么？ How come that you don't have to go!
怎么可以不用去呢！

Joey: I wish I could but I just found out that I have to be at work really early the next day, so I can't go, but, you know, take the extra ticket and invite whoever you want.
我希望可以，但我刚刚发现我第二天必须很早就上班，所以我不能去，但是，你知道，拿张额外的票并邀请任何你想要的人。

Chandler: (browsing through a diary) Uh, let's see, who do I hate?
（翻阅日记）呃，让我们看看，我讨厌谁？

Rachel: (gets up from the sofa and moves to the kitchen but Joey blocks her way) Oh, sorry...
（从沙发上站起来，走到厨房，但乔伊挡住了她的路）哦，对不起…… Oops, sorry.
哎呀，抱歉。

Joey: (lifts Rachel up and moves her behind him so she can walk on) Hey, here you go.
（把瑞秋举起来，把她移到身后，这样她就可以继续行走）嘿，给你。

Rachel: Ooh...
哦... oooh...
噢... (pause) (Rachel is all bah-jiggity about Joey) oh, ah...
（停顿）（瑞秋对乔伊充满了迷惑）哦，啊…… (pause) (to Monica) Can I ask you a question?
（停顿）（对莫妮卡）我可以问你一个问题吗？

Monica: Yeah.
是的。

Rachel: Do you think it's possible for two friends to fool around and...
你认为两个朋友有可能一起鬼混吗？ and not have it be a big deal?
这不是一件大事吗？

Monica: No, I don't think it ever works.
不，我认为它永远不会起作用。 Why?
为什么？

Rachel: No reason.
没有理由。

Monica: No, no, Rachel?
不，不，瑞秋？

Rachel: Yeah
是的

Monica: Who do you wanna fool around with?
你想和谁鬼混？

Rachel: (with high pitched voice) Nobody, forget it!
（高声）没人，算了！

(Monica points at Joey, Rachel turns and sees him)

Rachel: (giggling and whispering) Maybe.
（咯咯笑并低声）也许吧。

Monica: (whispering) You can't!
（小声）你不能！

Rachel: (whispering) Why?
（小声）为什么？ (Monica gesticulates mumbling something that starts with "because") Seriously I did not understand a word that you said.
（莫妮卡用手势咕哝着一些以“因为”开头的东西）说实话，我一个字都听不懂。

Monica: In the hall.
大厅里。

[Scene: In the hall]

Monica: You wanna fool around with Joey?
你想和乔伊鬼混吗？

Rachel: Yeah!
是的！ You know, ever since I had that dream about him, and can't get it out of my head!
你知道，自从我做了关于他的梦之后，它就一直在我的脑海里挥之不去！ And what's the big deal, people do it all the time!
有什么大不了的，人们总是这样做！

Monica: Who?
谁？ Who do you know that are friends that just fool around?
你认识哪两个朋友，只是上床玩玩而不谈感情？

Rachel: Ok, off the top of my head...
让我随便想一个…… Don and Janet.
唐和珍妮特。

Monica: Who, who are they?
谁，他们是谁？

Rachel: I know them from work.
我是在工作中认识他们的。

Monica: Both of them?
他们两个？

Rachel: No, one of them...
不，其中之一...

Monica: Which one?
哪一个？

Rachel: I don't know, what were the names I just said?
我不知道，我刚才说的名字是什么？

Monica: Rachel, things can get incredibly complicated.
瑞秋，事情会变得异常复杂。

Rachel: All right, all right, you're right, I won't do anything with Joey, I just thought that we (Joey enters the hall) Ok so that would be two cups of tarragon, one pound of baking soda and one red onion?
好吧，好吧，你说得对，我不会对乔伊做任何事，我只是想我们（乔伊进入大厅）好吧，那就是两杯龙蒿，一磅小苏打和一个红洋葱？ (Joey enters his apartment)

Monica: What the hell are you cooking!
你到底在煮什么菜啊！

Opening credits

[Scene: Central Perk, Ross enters]

Ross: Hey!
嘿！

Monica: Hey!
嘿！

Chandler: Hey!
嘿！

Ross: Hey, you guys won't believe what I have to do for work today.
嘿，你们不会相信我今天要做什么工作。

Chandler: Yes, but, Ross you chose a career of talking about dinosaurs.
是的，但是，罗斯，你选择了谈论恐龙的职业。

Ross: (covering with his hand Chandler's face, like pretending he's not there) (to Monica) There're these two professors who are joining my department and I have to meet them here and show them around campus.
（用手遮住钱德勒的脸，就像假装他不在那里一样）（对莫妮卡）有两位教授要加入我的系，我必须在这里与他们见面并带他们参观校园。

Monica: What's so bad about that?
这有什么不好呢？

Ross: It's I just know they're gonna be a couple of windbags wearing tweed jackets with suede elbow patches.
我只知道他们会是一对穿着花呢夹克、肘部贴有绒面革补丁的空谈家。

Monica: (fingering her elbow): Ross?
（指着她的肘部）：罗斯？

Ross: (looking his elbow, where there's a patch) These aren't suede.
（看看他的肘部，那里有一块补丁）这些不是绒面革。

(a woman walks in)

Charlie: (to Gunther) Excuse me, I'm looking for someone.
（对冈瑟）对不起，我正在找人。 You don't, by any chance, know a Ross Geller?
你不认识罗斯·盖勒吗？

Gunther: No.
不。

Ross: Hi, hi, I'm Ross Geller.
嗨，嗨，我是罗斯·盖勒。

Charlie: Oh, hi.
哦，嗨。 I'm professor Wealer.
我是韦勒教授。

Ross: Oh, oh, that's, that's, that's nice.
哦哦哦，这样啊，这样啊，真好啊

Charlie: It's a...
这是一个... It's good to meet you!
很高兴认识你！ Thank you so much for taking the time out to show me around.
非常感谢您抽出时间带我参观。

Ross: Oh, no, it's no big deal, I mean, if I weren't doing this I'd just, you know, be at the gym working out.
哦，不，这没什么大不了的，我的意思是，如果我不这样做，我就会，你知道，在健身房锻炼。

Monica: (to Chandler) Is he gonna introduce us?
（对钱德勒）他会介绍我们吗？

Chandler: (to Monica) No, I think we're just blurry shapes to him now.
（对莫妮卡）不，我想我们现在对他来说只是模糊的形状。

Charlie: And, by the way, I really enjoyed your paper on the connection between geographic isolation and rapid mutagenesis.
顺便说一句，我真的很喜欢你关于地理隔离和快速突变之间联系的论文。

Ross: Oh, ha, I wrote that in one minute.
哦，哈哈，我用一分钟就写完了。

Monica: (to chandler) Twenty bucks says they're married within the month.
（对钱德勒）二十块钱说他们一个月内就结婚了。

Ross: (hitting Monica with his suitcase) (to Charlie) We should probably get going, you know, we got a lot of ground to cover.
（用手提箱打莫妮卡）（对查理）我们也许应该出发了，你知道，我们还有很多工作要做。

Charlie: Oh, ah, isn't there another professor that is supposed to come with us?
哦，啊，不是还有一位教授要和我们一起去吗？

Ross: I don't think so.
我不这么认为。

Charlie: I'm pretty sure, professor Spafford from Cornell?
我很确定，康奈尔大学的斯帕福德教授？

Ross: Oh, well he's obviously late and the rule in my class is "if you can't come on time, then don't come at all".
哦，好吧，他显然迟到了，而我的班规是“如果你不能准时来，那就根本不来”。 (pause) An option that many of my students use.
（停顿）我的许多学生都使用这个选项。 (pause) Shall we?
（停顿）我们可以吗？

Charlie: You don't think we should wait for him?
你认为我们不应该等他吗？

Ross: You know what, he's a big boy, I'm sure he'll find us, ok?
你知道吗，他是个大男孩了，我相信他会找到我们，好吗？

Professor Spafford: Professor Geller?
盖勒教授？

Ross: Oh, damn it!
哦，该死！

[Scene: Joey's apartment]

(Rachel enters the room and checks the answering machine)

Jane: (from the answering machine) Hi Joey it's Jane Rogers, can't wait for your party tonight.
（电话答录机）嗨，乔伊，我是简·罗杰斯，等不及今晚的聚会了。 Listen, I forgot your address, can you give me a call?
听着，我忘记了你的地址，你能给我打电话吗？ Thanks, bye.
谢谢，再见。

Joey: (entering the room) Hey!
（进屋）嘿！

Rachel: Hey!
嘿！

Joey: What's happenin'?
发生了什么事'？

Rachel: Yeah, it's a real shame you can't make it to that one-woman show tonight.
是的，你不能参加今晚的独女秀真是太遗憾了。

Joey: Oh, I'd love to, but I gotta get up so early the next day and so, you know me, work comes first
哦，我很乐意，但第二天我必须起得很早，所以，你知道我，工作是第一位的

Rachel: Oh, yeah, yeah, yeah...
哦，是啊，是啊，是啊…… (she plays the answering machine)

Message: "Hi Joey, it's Jane Rogers can't wait for your party tonight" (Joey's upset and stops it)
“嗨，乔伊，我是简·罗杰斯，等不及今晚参加你的派对了”（乔伊很不高兴并停止了）

Joey: (yelling) Stupid Jane Rogers!!
（大喊）愚蠢的简·罗杰斯！！

Rachel: (angry) You are having a party tonight??
（生气）你今晚要开派对吗？？

Joey: Kinda have a...
有点像有... a thing for the Days Of Our Life's people.
就是《我们的日子》剧组同事的聚会。

Rachel: And you weren't going to tell us?
你不打算告诉我们吗？ How did you think you were gonna get away with that?
你以为你怎么能逃脱惩罚呢？

Joey: I do it every year.
我每年都会这样做。

Rachel: You do that every year??
你每年都这样做吗？？

Joey: I didn't have to tell you that!!
我本来不必告诉你的！ I'm stupider than Jane Rogers!!
我比简·罗杰斯还蠢！！

Rachel: Oh, that's why you got these tickets to that play, to get rid of us??
哦，这就是为什么你拿到了那场戏的门票，为了摆脱我们？

Joey: Yeah...
是的...

Rachel: And last year is that why you sent us to that medieval times restaurant?
去年这就是你派我们去那家中世纪餐厅的原因吗？

Joey: Yeah...
是的...

Rachel: OH!
哦！ And the year before that, when you set up that nighttime tour of that button factory?
前一年，当你安排夜间参观纽扣工厂时？

Joey: (Smiling) I can't believe you guys went for that one!
（微笑）我不敢相信你们竟然选择了那个！

Rachel: Joey, why wouldn't you invite us to your parties?
乔伊，你为什么不邀请我们参加你的聚会呢？

Joey: You're fine, ok?
你没事吧？ But everyone else acts like an idiot around famous people!
但其他人在名人面前却表现得像个白痴！

Rachel: Well, then so you just invite me...!
好吧，那你就邀请我吧……！

Joey: (speaking aloud) Please, I was trying to be nice, you're the worst one!
（大声说话）拜托，我只是想表现得友善一点，你是最糟糕的！

Rachel: Oh, Joey, come on!
哦，乔伊，加油！ Please, please!
拜托，拜托！ Let me come, I will behave, I promise!
让我来吧，我会好好表现的，我保证！ I will behave!
我会乖乖的！ Please, please, please...
拜托，拜托，拜托……

Joey: Ok, ok!
好吧，好吧！ Fine!
好吧！ You can come, but don't tell anybody else.
你可以来，但不要告诉其他人。 It's up on the roof at 8.
八点就到屋顶了。

Rachel: (yelling and jumping like a child) OH, a soap opera roof party!!
（像个孩子一样又喊又跳）哦，肥皂剧屋顶派对！！ I'm going to a soap opera roof party!!
我要去参加肥皂剧屋顶派对！！ Oh my God, oh my God!!
天哪，天啊！！ (realizing how she's behaving) And it's out of my system!
好了，我兴奋够了，正常了！

[Scene: Ross, Charlie and Professor Spafford are sitting at the table in a restaurant]

Professor Spafford: (speaking very slowly) And then my wife and I went on a cruise to the Galapagos.
（语速很慢）然后我和妻子乘船前往加拉帕戈斯群岛。 There was a sea food buffet you wouldn't believe.
有一个你不敢相信的海鲜自助餐。 There were clams, and mussels, and oysters, and cracked crab, and snow crab, and king crab.
有蛤蜊、贻贝、牡蛎、蟹壳、雪蟹和帝王蟹。 It's a pity I'm allergic to shellfish.
可惜我对贝类过敏。

Ross: (very bored, he tries to avoid the conversation speaking to Charlie) So, where did you get your undergraduate degree?
（非常无聊，他试图避免与查理交谈）那么，你在哪里获得本科学位？

Professor Spafford: And that's not all I'm allergic to.
我过敏的还不止这些。

Ross: (to Charlie) Oh, it's not over!
（对查理）哦，还没结束！

Professor Spafford: I'm also allergic to peanuts, and cashews, and almonds, and filberts...
我还对花生、腰果、杏仁、榛子过敏……

Ross: So basically all nuts?
那基本上所有坚果都过敏？

Professor Spafford: Interestingly...
有趣的是... no.
不。

Charlie: Kinda playing fast and loose with the word "interesting".
有点玩弄“有趣”这个词。

Professor Spafford: If you'll excuse me I'm going to use the restroom.
如果你不介意的话，我要去一下洗手间。 (he goes away)

Charlie: Oh my God!!
我的天啊！！

Ross: I've lost the will to live.
我已经失去了活下去的意志。

Charlie: Let's ditch him!
我们抛弃他吧！

Ross: What?
什么？

Charlie: Come on, he's still in the bathroom!
快点，他还在浴室里！ I'm begging you!
我求求你了！

Ross: Oh...
哦... ok, fine.
好吧，好吧。 But...
但... ehm...
嗯…… I just have one question for you, ehm...
我只想问你一个问题，嗯…… (aping Professor Spafford) When we exit should we walk, or run, or prance, or stroll...
（模仿斯帕福德教授）当我们退出时，我们应该走路、跑步、腾跃还是漫步……

Charlie: Stop it, stop it!
停下来，停下来！ He talks slow but he might pee fast!
他说话很慢，但尿尿可能很快！ Ok, let's go!!
好吧，我们走吧！！ (they run outside)

[Scene: Monica and Chandler's apartment]

Ross: (entering with Charlie) Oh, hey you guys!
（和查理一起进来）哦，嘿，你们！ This is Charlie!
这是查理！ Charlie, this is Phoebe and my sister, Monica.
查理，这是菲比和我的妹妹莫妮卡。

Phoebe: Hi!
你好！

Ross: Yeah, Charlie is gonna be joining my department.
是的，查理将加入我的部门。

Phoebe: Oh, you're a paleonthologist, too!
哦，你也是古生物学家！ (pause) Oh, ok, now, what do you think of Ranion's new theory of species' variegation in segmented arthopods?
（停顿）哦，好吧，现在，你对拉尼恩关于分节节肢动物物种杂色的新理论有何看法？

Charlie: Well, I think he's a little out there, but he does have some interesting ideas...
嗯，我认为他有点古怪，但他确实有一些有趣的想法......

Phoebe: Ah, ah.
啊，啊。

Charlie: (her mobile phone rings) Oh, I'm sorry.
（她的手机响了）哦，对不起。 I'll take this.
我接个电话。 Excuse me.
打扰一下。 (she cuts herself off for a moment)

Ross: (to Phoebe) Ranion's theory of species variegation?
（对菲比）拉尼恩的物种多样性理论？

Phoebe: Yeah, I saw the article on your coffee table and I memorized the title to freak you out!
是的，我在你的咖啡桌上看到了这篇文章，我记住了标题来吓唬你！

Monica: (to Ross) So, did you two have fun?
（对罗斯）那么，你们两个玩得开心吗？

Ross: Oh my God, she's great!
天哪，她太棒了！ I mean, we-we have so much in common and she's just cool, and funny...
我的意思是，我们——我们有很多共同点，而且她很酷、很有趣……

Monica: And I don't know if you've noticed but she's a (aloud) HOTTY!!
我不知道你是否注意到，但她（大声地）很性感！ (Charlie looks at her) HI!
（查理看着她）嗨！

Rachel: (she enters wearing a bath-robe) Hey...
（她穿着浴袍进来）嘿…… Hi you guys!
嗨，你们好！ Listen, you know what?
听着，你知道吗？ I'm not feeling really well.
我感觉不太好。 I think I can't get out for the play.
我想我不能出去看戏了。

Ross: Really?
真的吗？ Wh-what's wrong?
什、怎么了？

Rachel: I don't know!
我不知道！ I think it's kind of serious!
我觉得事情有点严重啊！ Oh, you know...
哦，你知道... I was watching this thing on TV this morning about...
今天早上我在电视上看到了这个关于... Newcastle disease...
新城疫... and I think I might have it!!
我想我可能会拥有它！

Charlie: Oh, Newcastle disease is a secretion borne virus that only affects chickens and...
哦，新城疫是一种分泌物传播的病毒，只影响鸡和...... other poultry.
其他家禽。

Rachel: ... Ok, who is this?
好吧，这是谁？

Ross: I'm sorry, Rachel, this is Charlie Wealer, she's a collegue.
抱歉，瑞秋，这是查理·韦勒，她是我的同事。

Rachel: Oh, hi!
哦，嗨！ I would check your hand but...
本想跟你握手，不过…… I'm sure you don't want to get my chicken disease!
我相信你不想得我的鸡病！

Monica: Hey, Rachel, Can-can I see you for a sec?
嘿，瑞秋，我可以见你一下吗？

Rachel: Sure!
当然！ (Monica takes her apart) Oh...
（莫妮卡将她分开）哦...

Monica: You're not sick!
你没病吧！

Rachel: What?
什么？ Yes, I am!
我是！

Monica: Ok, then, why are you...
好吧，那你为什么... (she opens her robe revealing a nice black dress) all dressed up??
（她打开长袍，露出一件漂亮的黑色连衣裙）都盛装打扮了？

Rachel: When you're sick, you do whatever you can to make yourself feel better!
当你生病的时候，你会尽一切努力让自己感觉好一点！ (she closes her robe)

Monica: You just wanna stay home so you can make a move on Joey!
你只想呆在家里，这样你就可以对乔伊采取行动！

Rachel: Oh, no, no!
哦，不，不！ I heard you before, that is so not what this is!
我以前听过你的话，那不是这个！

Monica: Ok, what is this?
好吧，这是什么？

Rachel: Ok!
好的！ (whispering) Joey is having a secret Days Of Our Lives party up on the roof and he sent you guys to the play to get rid of you!
（小声）乔伊正在屋顶上举办一场秘密的《我们的日子》派对，他派你们去看戏是为了除掉你们！

Monica: (aloud) WHAT?
（大声）什么？

Ross: (looking at them) Wh-what's going on?
（看着他们）什、发生了什么事？

Monica: Joey is having a secret Days Of Our Lives party up on the roof!
乔伊正在屋顶举办秘密的“我们的日子”派对！

Rachel: And he didn't want you guys to know about it but I came over here to tell you!!
他不想让你们知道这件事，但我来这里是为了告诉你们！

Charlie: I thought you came to say you were sick.
我以为你来是说你病了。

Rachel: Ok professor or detective?
好的教授还是侦探？

Phoebe: Joey's having a party and he wasn't gonna invite us?
乔伊要开派对，他不邀请我们？

Rachel: Yeah, and he does it every year!
是的，他每年都这样做！ That's why he's sending you to that play!
这就是他送你去看那场戏的原因！ That's why he sent us to that medieval restaurant and to that button factory!
这就是为什么他派我们去那家中世纪餐厅和那个纽扣工厂！

Phoebe: And that horrible museum tour!
还有那个可怕的博物馆之旅！

Ross: No, I arranged that...
不，是我安排的……

(Joey enters, wearing a bathrobe)

Joey: (sounds tired) Hey you guys, I'm turning in.
